final: WITH unit_shares AS (SELECT zoneref, articount, 1.0 * articount / NULLIF(SUM(articount) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM scanfeatures), shares_with_average AS (SELECT zoneref, articount, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM unit_shares) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, articount AS artifact_count, share, share - average_share AS share_difference FROM shares_with_average WHERE average_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY share_difference IS NULL, share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
